workbookSettings.title: Accounts template
workbookSettings.description: Your accountant's template decides which headings you can use and where each amount ends up.
workbookSettings.templateEmpty: No template yet. It is the Excel workbook your accountant uses for your annual accounts, and LedgerHarbour needs it to fill it in from your invoices.
workbookSettings.confirmReplace: Replace the current template? Codes you have already used are kept, and renamed headings keep their names.
workbookSettings.headingCounts: Headings: {inserted} added, {updated} updated, {missing} no longer in the template.
workbookSettings.tooLargeError: This file is too large. The template must be 10 MB or smaller.
workbookSettings.notWorkbookError: This file is not an Excel workbook (.xlsx).
workbookSettings.notTemplateError: This does not look like your accountant's accounts template. Check that you picked the right file.
workbookSettings.accessError: You do not have permission to change the template or the chart of accounts.
workbookSettings.uploadError: We could not read the template. Please try again.
workbookSettings.loadError: We could not load the template settings. Please try again.
workbookSettings.adviceIntro: LedgerHarbour already works around the small quirks of the template. These points can still change your accounts, so pass them on to your accountant.
workbookSettings.adviceNone: Nothing in this template changes your figures, so there is nothing to tell your accountant.

brokenReference.one: Your rows are still filled in, but 1 formula in the template points at something that was deleted, so the statements will show errors until your accountant repairs it.
brokenReference.other: Your rows are still filled in, but {count} formulas in the template point at something that was deleted, so the statements will show errors until your accountant repairs them.

defects.truncatedColumn: Some columns stop calculating partway down, so only this many rows can be used safely until your accountant extends them: {sheets}.
defects.staleClosingBalance: The closing balance at the bottom of {sheets} can be wrong once the sheet gets long, so ask your accountant to check it.

unconsolidatedSheet.one: {sheets} is not added into the accounts, so your accountant has to enter its totals by hand.
unconsolidatedSheet.other: {sheets} are not added into the accounts, so your accountant has to enter their totals by hand.

headingTotal.one: The app will not let you use {headings}, because the template does not add its total into the accounts correctly; your accountant needs to fix this.
headingTotal.other: The app will not let you use {headings}, because the template does not add their totals into the accounts correctly; your accountant needs to fix this.

blankHeading.one: The template has a heading with no name. The app never sends a row without a code, so nothing lands there by mistake, but your accountant may want to remove it.
blankHeading.other: The template has {count} headings with no name. The app never sends a row without a code, so nothing lands there by mistake, but your accountant may want to remove them.

workbookSettings.chartHint: Numbered headings are spare lines your accountant has not named yet. Give one a name and activate it to make it available.
workbookSettings.chartEmpty: Upload the template to see its headings.

blocked.blank_heading: Blocked: the template gives it no name.
blocked.marked_do_not_use: Blocked: the template marks it as not to be used.
blocked.total_not_read: Blocked: its total is not added into the accounts.
blocked.total_read_twice: Blocked: its total is added into the accounts twice.
blocked.truncated_formula: Blocked: its column does not calculate on every row.
blocked.missing_from_template: Blocked: it is no longer in the current template.

moneySettings.title: Money accounts and year
moneySettings.description: Set the dates your accounts cover and the bank and cash accounts your money moves through, so every invoice lands on the right sheet of your accountant's workbook.
moneySettings.loadError: We could not load the year and the accounts. Please try again.
moneySettings.readOnly: You can see these settings, but you do not have permission to change them.
moneySettings.yearHint: The financial year is the period your annual accounts cover; every movement must fall inside an open year.
moneySettings.yearEmpty: No financial year yet. Create it first: most businesses use 1 January to 31 December, but use the dates your accountant gave you.
moneySettings.nextYearHint: No year is open. Start the next year to keep recording movements.
moneySettings.oneOpenYear: Only one year can be open at a time: close this one before you start the next.
moneySettings.confirmClose: Close this financial year? Its movements become read-only until you reopen it.
moneySettings.accountsHint: Your bank accounts and your cash box: each payment comes out of one of them.
moneySettings.noTemplate: Upload your accountant's template first: each account writes to one of its sheets.
moneySettings.noOpenYear: Open a financial year to set opening balances.
moneySettings.accountsEmpty: No accounts yet. Add your bank account first.
moneySettings.openingHint: This is the balance on the first day of the year, in pounds; put a minus sign in front if the account was overdrawn, for example -80.50.
moneySettings.sheetHint: Each account fills one sheet of your accountant's workbook, so pick the sheet your accountant uses for that bank or for cash.
moneySettings.noFreeSheet: Every sheet of the template already has an account. Deactivate an account to free its sheet.

errors.FINANCIAL_YEAR_OVERLAP: These dates overlap another financial year. Pick dates that start after the previous year ends.
errors.FINANCIAL_YEAR_ALREADY_OPEN: Another year is already open. Close it before you open this one.
errors.FINANCIAL_YEAR_HAS_MOVEMENTS: This year already has movements, so its dates can no longer change.
errors.FINANCIAL_YEAR_CLOSED: This year is closed, so its opening balances cannot change. Reopen it first.
errors.INVALID_FINANCIAL_YEAR: Enter a start date and an end date after it.
errors.MONEY_ACCOUNT_NAME_TAKEN: Another active account already has this name.
errors.SHEET_ALREADY_USED: Another active account already writes to this sheet. Pick another sheet or deactivate that account first.
errors.UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE_SHEET: This sheet is not in the current template. Reload the page and pick another.
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount in pounds with up to two decimals, for example 1250.00 or -80.50.
errors.INVALID_MONEY_ACCOUNT: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
errors.FINANCIAL_YEAR_NOT_FOUND: This year is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.MONEY_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.MONEY_REPOSITORY_CONFLICT: This changed elsewhere. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY: You do not have permission to change the year or the accounts.
